family.name: Broadcast
family.what: TV, sport and live-event graphics: lower thirds, tickers, scorebugs, league tables, election maps, idents and on-air clocks.

presets.name: Football matchday package
presets.what: Deep royal purple with electric green and hot magenta, a slabbed league table of condensed caps, rows that push in hard.
presets.not: Not the generic sports broadcast: one owned brand palette (purple, green, magenta) and table-led data, not navy stat tiles with yellow hits.

presets.name: Racecard form guide
presets.what: Turf-green card with cream slab-serif runners, gold odds chips and thin newsprint rules, like a racecard read trackside.
presets.not: Not a league table package: a printed racecard's slab serif, rules and odds, calm and traditional rather than loud and slabbed.

presets.name: Courtside stat package
presets.what: One towering condensed stat in broadcast red on black, a white caption rule, a player trend chart, cuts on every beat.
presets.not: Not a metric count-up: dark, red and sport-coded with a player's trend panel, not a neutral black-on-white KPI.

presets.name: On-air countdown clock
presets.what: A white studio clock ring on black with a red sweeping second arc, monospaced time readouts and stepped, ticking reveals.
presets.not: Not a sci-fi HUD: a real studio clock in black, white and on-air red; nothing futuristic, only time running out.

presets.name: Olympic-style pictogram system
presets.what: Crisp white modular tiles, solid ring-colour blocks in blue, red, green and black, flat geometric pictograms and tight bold sans.
presets.not: Not a bento product showcase: an event identity system of pictograms and ring colours on white, not device UI tiles.

presets.name: Game-show board
presets.what: Saturated TV-blue tiles on a midnight set, gold compressed numbers, black gaps between cells, marquee sparkles and pop-in reveals.
presets.not: Not arcade pixels: a studio board of big glossy tiles and gold numbers, not a retro game screen.

presets.name: Esports match overlay
presets.what: A hard split between deep-navy blue side and signal-red red side, angular techno caps crossing the seam, instant snaps.
presets.not: Not a cyberpunk neon look: flat team colours and a hard versus split, no glow, rain or city lights.

presets.name: Election-night map
presets.what: White districts on cool grey, red and blue regions filling in, hatched too-close-to-call areas, pinned results in a newsroom sans.
presets.not: Not a map explainer: a results map, two opposing colours filling regions and calls being made, not a route between places.

presets.name: TV weather map
presets.what: Pale green land on a mid-blue sea, isobar contours, warm-front orange and cold-front cyan regions, temperature pins in friendly rounded sans.
presets.not: Not an election map: a natural sea-and-land palette with isobars and temperatures, not two opposing result colours.

presets.name: Breaking-news band
presets.what: Footage under a white lower-third slab with a red Breaking tab, navy crawl band, yellow Live chip and a channel bug.
presets.not: Not a news package: only the on-air overlay layer (tab, slab, crawl, bug) over footage, no studio panels or globes.

ticker: More to follow on this story

presets.name: Business-news ticker
presets.what: Dusk skyline footage, a dark navy lower third in condensed sans, blue Markets tab, green movers chip and a monospaced price crawl.
presets.not: Not a financial terminal: broadcast overlays over footage with a scrolling price crawl, not an amber screen of dense tables.

presets.name: Late-night talk show
presets.what: A glowing city-at-dusk backdrop in midnight navy and marquee gold, a high-contrast display serif headline, curtain-red touches, warm studio glow.
presets.not: Not a cinematic title: a studio set's skyline, marquee gold and warm glow, sized for chat and laughs rather than drama.

presets.name: Awards-show gold
presets.what: Cream serif capitals with deep gold 3D extrusion on black, a gold star, spotlight rays fanning behind and a specular glint.
presets.not: Not black-and-gold luxury: showbiz and spotlit, with extruded trophy type and rays, not quiet hairlines and engraved restraint.

presets.name: Morning-show sunshine
presets.what: Sky-blue set with soft sunny blobs, rounded white cards stacked as the rundown, yellow and coral icons, a chunky friendly sans.
presets.not: Not pastel minimal: a busy, sunny daytime-TV rundown of cards and icons, not sparse calm pastel space.

presets.name: Public-broadcaster clean
presets.what: Pure white with one sober news red, a plain grotesk headline, ruled margins, flat grey data cards and nothing decorative.
presets.not: Not Swiss poster type: a newsroom explainer system of cards and charts, restrained and legible rather than typographic art.

presets.name: Live-stream overlay
presets.what: Near-black stream UI with charcoal chat rows, the headline as a purple highlighted message, green avatars and fast-scrolling replies.
presets.not: Not an AI chat product: a crowd of viewers reacting live in stream colours, not a calm one-to-one assistant conversation.

presets.name: 80s network ident
presets.what: Early-CGI blocks in red, yellow and cyan on a wireframed floor, cobalt sky, white edge lines, wide techno caps, scanlines and a glint.
presets.not: Not synthwave: primary-colour CGI blocks and broadcast scanlines from a TV station, no neon sunsets or magenta grids.

presets.name: Stadium jumbotron
presets.what: Huge blocky caps smashed across a black LED dot field, a red slab, a yellow disc, one word turned sideways, flashing on the beat.
presets.not: Not a big-type poster: an LED-screen crowd prompt with a pixel dot field and chunky display caps, flashing rather than composed.

presets.name: Grass-court championship
presets.what: Crisp white with deep grass green and royal purple, a bookish serif headline, the draw as a timeline from first round to final.
presets.not: Not a roadmap explainer: a tournament draw in heritage green and purple with a serif voice, not a startup timeline.

presets.name: Home-shopping channel
presets.what: A giant red price on white with a sunburst behind, navy caption rule, yellow offset panels and everything popping in with a bounce.
presets.not: Not hard-sell retail: a clean white TV set with one giant price and a sales trend, not a red sale flyer covered in stickers.
